text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, during the lead-up to the Oka
Sho—the
first race of the Triple Tiara
tour...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
We're going out. There's somewhere I
wanna go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You decide!
choice_data_list: よし、どこに行きたいんだ？
うん、どこに行きたいの？

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm only going to tell you what kind of place I wanna go to. You have to decide where.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And you have to pick somewhere that meets all the conditions I give you! Got it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I manage to find somewhere that meets
the
conditions she gives me—in other
words,
somewhere with a lot of flowers
and full of
magical power.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... I think this place'll do. It's
nowhere near
as nice as Granny's
garden, though!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come along, Familiar! I realized a while
ago that
you know hardly anything
about flowers.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now that you've ranked up, you need to
learn
about this kind of thing! Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Sweep Tosho has spent a short
while telling
me about the kinds of
magic that various flowers
possess...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, Familiar?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I think you hold the first clue to me
finding that
racing magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You think it looks like magic when I run,
right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Then you have to tell me more. Directly.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: How do you feel when you see me run?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Your answers really should have ranked
up with
you, by the way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has a point. In her eyes, I've become
a
high-ranking familiar.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I could only really offer my vague
impressions
before. This time, though...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh. Go on.
choice_data_list: 俺は、君の走りを見ると、いつも――
私は、貴方の走りを見ると、いつも――

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's like everything I've seen before gets
blown
away, and the world gets
repainted with new
colors.
choice_data_list: 新しい何かが始まりそうでワクワクするんだ
新しい何かが始まりそうでワクワクするの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's the way I feel every time I see her
run.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (It's the same.)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(That's exactly how I feel whenever I see
Granny
casting magic...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...I knew it. I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm casting it on you—I'm casting
my racing
magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But that's not enough. My magic's
nowhere near
complete! I need the
whole world to be under my
spell!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I need to make my magic
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I have to make the spell more powerful! It has to be so powerful that it works on everyone who watches! Not just you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So how am I supposed to do that?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! All this thinking is making me
hungry! More
pancakes, Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...And if you come up with any ideas,
you better
tell me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're supposed to give me advice,
remember!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try as hard as I can to think of a way to

strengthen this spell that's been cast on
me alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What if she tried approaching the whole
racing
magic idea like it was new again?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first time I felt the potential of
Sweep Tosho's
magic was...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind. I'm gonna run.
And you're
all in for a treat.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading to the Twinkle Series to find
the
magic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was the first time she was genuinely
interested
in the Twinkle Series. That
was when she sensed
the potential of
racing magic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it's because the Twinkle Series
has
captivating, special races that
fascinate both fans
and Umamusume
alike.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If those special races hold the secret to her racing magic, then...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
An extra special race? ...And what
exactly does
that mean?
choice_data_list: ……もっと『特別』なレースをしよう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I tell her that if we keep on going,
we'll
almost certainly find our answer.
And that's
because...
choice_data_list: 正直、それはまだわからないけど――

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a once-in-a-lifetime race into which
the
competing Umamusume pour their
pride, their
souls, and their strength.
choice_data_list: 俺たちの目標は『桜花賞』だ
私たちの目標は『桜花賞』でしょ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No matter who you ask...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. I see where you're coming from.
choice_data_list: そんなことは、絶対にないから！

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Well, it is true that really powerful magic needs a special incantation as well as a special place to cast it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So... Okay, let's go for it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do it, Familiar! I'll run special
races on
my road to the Triple Tiara...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And perfect my racing magic along the
way!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho is about to begin! Just
which
Umamusume is going to bring
home the first tiara
of the year?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Each of the competitors has made their
way to
the paddock!
